spanish: Y desaparecerá el deseo de los pastores, y la huida de los jefes del rebaño.

findings.issue: מָנ֖וֹס rendered as 'deseo' (desire) instead of refuge/escape
מִן הָרֹעִים parsed as possessive 'de los pastores' instead of 'from the shepherds'
אַדִּירֵי rendered as 'jefes' (chiefs) without token support for that specialization
